name: Cloak of Invisibility

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Pull up the hood
powers.text: Magic action: you're Invisible while the hood is up (up to 1 hour a day, in 1-minute steps).

summary: Pull up the hood to be Invisible, up to an hour a day.
text: Pulling the hood over your head is a Magic action that gives you the Invisible condition, and everything you wear or carry vanishes along with you. Removing the hood takes a Bonus Action. The cloak holds 1 hour of invisibility in total, spent in 1-minute increments, and all of it returns at dawn.
